Thanks again for running the interviews with Arjun yesterday. I pulled together the scorecard export and a quick strawpoll so we can close this loop before the afternoon debrief. Can you do two quick things by EOD today?

1) Post your numeric score (1–5) in reply and one-line rationale (bullet is fine).
2) If you have any red flags (technical gaps, culture concerns), call them out explicitly.

Attached: resume_arjun_singh.pdf and panel_notes_arjun_v2.xlsx. Greenhouse scorecard: https://greenhouse.io/candidates/4821. Strawpoll (vote only): https://strawpoll.com/kS9f2x

Quick guidance on thresholds: 4–5 = move to onsite/offer consideration; 3 = borderline (ask for specific rationale); 1–2 = keep on hold. Try to stick to concrete examples from the interview where possible (e.g., system design, test-writing, ambiguity handling).

I will aggregate results and post the tally around 4:30pm PT. If anyone needs more time, ping me here.
